name: Idli
note: Steamed. Parboiled rice and urad dal, 3 to 1, soaked, ground and fermented.

name: Plain dosa
note: Rice and urad dal batter, with a little oil on the griddle.

name: Pesarattu
note: Whole green gram batter with a little rice, ginger and chilli, onion on top.

name: Rava upma
note: Roasted rava cooked in three times its weight of water, with onion and a tempering.

name: Gunta ponganalu
note: Leftover dosa batter with onion, chilli and ginger, cooked in a ponganalu pan with a little oil. Some homes use rava or maida instead.

name: Minapa garelu (urad vada)
note: Deep-fried. Counts the oil a vada soaks up, about 12 g in 100 g, not the frying oil.

name: Punugulu
note: Deep-fried balls of dosa batter with a little rava, onion and chilli. Counts the oil soaked up, about 14 g in 100 g.

name: Atukulu upma (poha)
note: Rinsed poha tossed with a tempering of peanuts, onion and chilli, finished with lemon. Poha is valued as white rice, because USDA has no rice flakes.

name: Pongal
note: Rice and moong dal, 2 to 1, cooked soft with pepper, cumin and ginger in ghee.

name: Onion uttapam
note: Thick rice and urad dal pancake topped with onion, tomato and chilli.

name: Pulihora (tamarind rice)
note: Cooked rice mixed with a tamarind and chilli paste and a peanut tempering. Jaggery is valued as brown sugar.

name: Nimmakaya pulihora (lemon rice)
note: Cooked rice with turmeric, a peanut and dal tempering, and lemon juice.

name: Perugu annam (curd rice)
note: Soft-cooked rice mashed with curd and a little milk, with a light tempering.

name: Tomato rice
note: Rice cooked into a spiced tomato and onion base.

name: Vegetable pulao
note: Rice cooked with mixed vegetables and whole spices in ghee and oil. Basmati is valued as long-grain rice.

name: Vegetable biryani
note: Layered rice and spiced vegetables with fried onion, curd, mint and whole spices. Biryani masala has no data and is left out.

name: Pappu (toor dal)
aliases: muddha pappu;kandi pappu;toor dal;arhar dal;tuvar dal;dal;paruppu
note: Toor dal cooked thick with turmeric and green chilli, with an oil tempering.

name: Tomato pappu
note: Toor dal cooked with tomatoes, onion and chilli, with a tempering.

name: Palakura pappu (spinach dal)
note: Toor dal cooked with spinach, tomato and chilli, with a tempering.

name: Sambar
note: Toor dal and vegetables in tamarind, with sambar spices. Sambar powder is entered as the spices in it.

name: Charu (rasam)
note: Thin tamarind and tomato broth with pepper, cumin and garlic.

name: Majjiga pulusu
note: Curd and water simmered with a coconut, chilli and ginger paste and okra, thickened with a little besan.

name: Bendakaya vepudu (okra fry)
aliases: bendakaya fry;bhindi fry;okra fry;vendakkai poriyal;bhindi sabzi
note: Okra stir-fried until crisp with chilli powder.

name: Vankaya kura (brinjal curry)
note: Brinjal cooked with onion, tomato and spices.

name: Bangaladumpa vepudu (potato fry)
note: Potato cubes fried with chilli powder and a tempering.

name: Cabbage kura
note: Cabbage cooked with soaked chana dal, chilli and a little coconut.

name: Beans kura
note: Green beans cooked with a tempering and a little coconut.

name: Chapati
note: Whole wheat dough rolled thin and cooked on a dry pan.

name: Poori
note: Wheat dough rolled small and deep-fried. Counts the oil a poori soaks up, about 15 g in 100 g, not the frying oil.

name: Paratha
note: Layered whole wheat flatbread cooked on a pan with oil. Made with ghee, it changes little but the fats.

name: Coconut chutney
note: Fresh coconut ground with roasted chana dal, green chilli and ginger, with a tempering. Roasted chana dal is valued as raw chickpeas.

name: Tomato pachadi
note: Tomatoes cooked down with chillies, garlic and a little tamarind, then ground.

name: Palli chutney (peanut chutney)
aliases: palli pachadi;peanut chutney;groundnut chutney;verusenaga chutney;kadalai chutney
note: Roasted peanuts ground with green chilli, a little tamarind and garlic, with a tempering. Peanuts are valued raw.

name: Semiya payasam
note: Vermicelli simmered in milk with sugar, ghee, cashews, raisins and cardamom.

name: Rava kesari
note: Roasted rava cooked in water and ghee with plenty of sugar, cashews and raisins.

name: Chai
note: Tea boiled with milk and sugar. The tea is entered as brewed black tea.

name: Filter coffee
note: Coffee decoction with hot milk and sugar. The decoction is entered as ordinary brewed coffee, so caffeine reads low.

name: Majjiga (buttermilk)
note: Curd whisked with water, salt, ginger, chilli and coriander.
